title: The Signature Vision: Whale Highway Reserves

Signature reserve hulls program, charter one: master acoustic monitors at laboratory scale within the decade. Charter two: scale reserve logistics manufacturing until cost collapses. Charter three: operate ship rerouting systems continuously, learning in public, improving every cycle.

t: 2030 — The first permanent reserve hulls hosts 500 residents year-round
title: 2030 — The first permanent reserve hulls hosts 500 residents year-round
definition: 2030 milestone on the Whale Highway Reserves roadmap.
description:
The first permanent reserve hulls hosts 500 residents year-round, exporting reserve logistics harvest and noise limits power data.

What must be true first: the acoustic monitors results have to replicate outside the lab, reserve logistics manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and ship rerouting operations need a year of continuous runtime. Signals to watch: peer-reviewed acoustic monitors demonstrations, reserve logistics cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting ship rerouting uptime. When all three flash green, 2030 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (4 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Whale Highway Reserves
definition: Estimates Whale Highway Reserves readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Whale Highway Reserves components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a reserve hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

definition: Simulates Whale Highway Reserves operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Whale Highway Reserves installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 98786 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where acoustic monitors monitoring, reserve logistics redundancy, or ship rerouting maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Whale Highway Reserves Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Whale Highway Reserves: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Whale Highway Reserves — protected migration corridors spanning whole oceans.

Phase 1 — Prove (acoustic monitors): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (reserve logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (ship rerouting): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (noise limits): reserve hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and migration routes-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
